needsFramework.name: Mainstream and standard laptops
needsFramework.typicalUsers: General staff, administrative personnel, operations, finance/accounting and legal teams.
needsFramework.requirements: Balance cost and performance for general-purpose workloads — SaaS, browsers, collaboration platforms, office suites and endpoint-security agents still create real CPU/memory/network load.
needsFramework.productFit: Strong — mainstream business-tier configurations for standard business use, with larger-screen options where productivity benefits from it.
needsFramework.hardExclusions: None obvious for general-purpose Windows workloads; exact enterprise management/support requirements still need validation.

needsFramework.name: Ultraportable laptops
needsFramework.typicalUsers: Executives, sales teams, field managers, marketing teams and other frequent travellers.
needsFramework.requirements: Reduced weight and long battery life are the defining needs, alongside standard enterprise security/manageability.
needsFramework.productFit: Very strong — lightweight premium positioning is directly relevant to mobile/client-facing roles.
needsFramework.hardExclusions: If a buyer requires a specific unsupported form factor or platform, validate before including in Product SAM.

needsFramework.name: Performance laptops
needsFramework.typicalUsers: Software developers, engineers, data scientists, AI/ML specialists, product designers and other power users.
needsFramework.requirements: High-end CPU/GPU capability, large RAM, strong thermal control; virtualization and local AI materially increase resource requirements.
needsFramework.productFit: Partial/strong — higher-spec non-workstation configurations can serve CPU/RAM-heavy workloads.
needsFramework.hardExclusions: Discrete NVIDIA/CUDA, professional GPU, or workstation-certified requirement is a hard exclusion for VAIO's current range.

needsFramework.name: Security and compliance-focused laptops
needsFramework.typicalUsers: Government, healthcare, finance, legal, cybersecurity/IT admin, executives and other stricter-security roles.
needsFramework.requirements: Locked-down firmware, enhanced encryption, longer support cycles and enterprise security features (TPM/secure boot/biometrics).
needsFramework.productFit: Potential fit, not assumed — needs validation of security features, firmware lifecycle, remote manageability and local warranty/support.
needsFramework.hardExclusions: Any mandatory enterprise security/manageability capability the brand cannot meet becomes a SAM exclusion.

needsFramework.name: Specialized / mission-critical application requirement
needsFramework.typicalUsers: Users of custom enterprise applications, certified software, specialized peripherals or platform-specific tools.
needsFramework.requirements: Hardware must satisfy the specific software's processor/platform, driver, peripheral and certification requirements.
needsFramework.productFit: Case-by-case — map the exact application requirement to the closest configuration.
needsFramework.hardExclusions: Unsupported processor/platform certification, specialist peripheral requirement, or discrete workstation GPU can exclude the brand.
